words.def: a person who applies for a job
words.ex: There were five strong {candidates} for the role.

words.def: a short letter you send with your CV explaining why you want the job
words.ex: Her {cover letter} explained exactly why she was a good fit.

words.def: right or appropriate for a particular job or situation
words.ex: I'm not sure I'm {suitable} for such a technical role.

words.def: to do something that gets you noticed or shows what you can do
words.ex: She wanted to {make her mark} early, so she volunteered for the hardest projects.

words.def: a particular job within an organisation
words.ex: It was a senior {position}, so the advert asked for three years' experience.

words.def: work or skills that are directly useful for a particular job
words.ex: Do you have any {relevant experience} for this kind of work?

words.def: to volunteer or apply for something, especially a job
words.ex: It can feel daunting to {put yourself forward} for a senior role.

words.def: hard to get because many people want it; also describes good pay
words.ex: The salary is {competitive}, and so is the number of applicants.
